title: Own the Context, Rent the Model: starter kit
description: Topic-free template repository accompanying the article 'Own the Context, Rent the Model: Design Principles for a Local, Auditable Research Assistant for Literature Synthesis and Statistical Analysis' (journal version under review). An earlier working-paper version appeared on SSRN (DOI 10.2139/ssrn.7171998). The repository contains a page-anchored summary template, agent contracts for import, verification, correction and a scheduled questioning pass, a taxonomy structure with neutral example tags, maintenance scripts for links, hubs, statistics, graph measures, taxonomy and DOI checks, and a number guard that binds manuscript numbers to a frozen run or a sourced register. The example vault is synthetic and entirely invented. No literature, data or licensed text is included. Licensing: the code in scripts/ is released under the MIT License, and all texts, templates, agent briefs and the example are released under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). See LICENSE.
